articles.title: After meeting PM Modi, schoolmate gets land back from BJP MLA
articles.summary: BJP MLA Narendra Mehta has agreed to relinquish contested land and retract his complaint against Asgar Ali Vora, a senior schoolmate of Prime Minister Modi. This decision came after Vora approached the Prime Minister for assistance regarding the land issue.

articles.title: ‘Killer bahu left out of will’: What triggered Kanpur pharma trader’s murder plot
articles.summary: Police are investigating a murder case involving a pharmaceutical trader's will. The will excluded the trader's daughter-in-law, Shalu, from property inheritance.

articles.title: Jos Buttler breaks Rohit Sharma's record, becomes second-highest T20I run-scorer
articles.summary: Jos Buttler has now become the second-highest run-scorer in men's T20I cricket. He achieved this milestone during England's victory against Sri Lanka.

NYC agrees to $60M settlement with owners of 64 seized properties; Zohran Mamdani plans TPT revival
articles.summary: New York City has agreed to pay $60 million to owners of 64 properties seized under its Third Party Transfer program over unpaid taxes and other debts. The settlement follows a class-action lawsuit alleging owners were denied proper compensation.

articles.title: Built in 1976, Diane Keaton bought $6.6M Laguna home, transformed, sold for $7.9M, now listed for $10.3M
articles.summary: Diane Keaton’s Laguna Beach home, built in 1976, was purchased by the actress for $6.6 million in 2021 and transformed before being sold for $7.9 million a year later. Now, the four-bedroom oceanfront property is back on the market for $10.3 million, with Keaton’s distinctive design touches and lighting still intact..

articles.title: Meet Brooke Sumpter, 11, who learned to sew at 4 and designed an American Girl collection
articles.summary: Brooke Sumpter, an 11-year-old fashion designer, has made history by becoming the first child to design an American Girl fashion collection. She began learning to sew at just four and has now created the Cherry Blossom Couture Collection with Harlem’s Fashion Row and Mattel, featuring stylish outfits for American Girl’s 18-inch dolls..

articles.title: Haiwaan Day 5 Box Office: film stays at Rs 70 lakh in India
articles.summary: Haiwaan (Akshay Kumar, Saif Ali Khan), a remake of Priyadarshan's Oppam, released September 11 to mixed reviews and weak box office. Day 5 collections stayed flat at Rs 70 lakh net, taking India net to Rs 8.75 crore; worldwide gross is Rs 13.61 crore.
